text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both gaining ground with BTC up 2.4% and ETH outpacing it at 3.4%, suggesting selective strength in the two majors despite extreme fear sentiment. The Fear & Greed index sitting at 25 with a recent uptick indicates markets may be stabilizing after deeper pessimism, though conviction remains fragile. Bitcoin dominance at 56.3% and $73B in daily volume reflect moderate activity—enough to support these moves but not the sustained buying that would signal a broader shift in mood.
